module: Flowgraph node "Rally Mode Fire Rally Event" (category once_instant, tag rally). Fires a rally event: calls extensions.hook('on' .. eventType, {show = show}) and guihooks.trigger(eventType, {show = show}). Inputs: eventType (string, event name without the "on" prefix) and show (bool, default true, show the corresponding UI).
notes: If eventType is nil, the concatenation 'on'..nil causes a Lua error.

workOnce.desc: Calls the extension hook and the guihook corresponding to eventType with {show = ...}.
